secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Hosted Supabase project URL (https://<project>.supabase.co). From your Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project URL.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public key (publishable). From Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project API keys → anon public.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Same Supabase project URL, exposed to the client bundle (VITE_ prefix). From Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project URL.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Same Supabase anon/public key, exposed to the client bundle (VITE_ prefix). From Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project API keys → anon public.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for the AI crop-doctor feature. From Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com). Server-only — do NOT add a VITE_ prefix.

secrets.name: PAYFAST_MERCHANT_ID
secrets.description: PayFast merchant ID for premium subscription payments. From PayFast merchant dashboard. Server-only.

secrets.name: PAYFAST_MERCHANT_KEY
secrets.description: PayFast merchant key for premium subscription payments. From PayFast merchant dashboard. Server-only.

secrets.name: PAYFAST_PASSPHRASE
secrets.description: PayFast passphrase used to sign/verify payment signatures. From PayFast merchant dashboard → Settings → Passphrase. Server-only.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Optional privileged Supabase service-role key for server-side admin operations. From Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → service_role. Server-only.

secrets.name: LOVABLE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional alternative AI gateway key, used only if GEMINI_API_KEY is unset. From Lovable Cloud. Server-only.
